### Task Information:
## Task Description: There are several blocks with different colors on the table. There are two serve points: serve_point_1 is on the tray on the table, and serve_point_2 is in front of the human (same area as the human).

## Task Goal:
Stack the blocks into 2 pile(s). 

- Goal pile_1 -> serve_point_1 (on tray) goal_top_down: [blue on red on black].
- Goal pile_2 -> serve_point_2 (in front of human) goal_top_down: [orange on green on yellow].

goal_top_down means [TOP on ... on BOTTOM]. The BOTTOM block of each pile must be at the serve_point. Only one block at one point.

## Task related objects: red_block, yellow_block, green_block, blue_block, orange_block, black_block
## Task related points: serve_point_1, serve_point_2, overlap_point_1, overlap_point_2

The human is standing in the overlap area, the tray is at the left area, the red_block is at the right area, the green_block is at the overlap area, the blue_block is at the left area, the yellow_block is at the right area, the orange_block is at the left area, and the black_block is at the overlap area. Initial stacks are: - Init stack_1: init_top_down [orange on blue].; - Init stack_2: init_top_down [green on black].; - Init stack_3: init_top_down [red on yellow].. init_top_down means [TOP on ... on BOTTOM].
